s: Shetiyyat hayyayin achar habberaka vedinayv, ubo ch' seipim: acher shessiyyem birkat hammazon tzarik lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al hakkos shel birkat hammazon apillu im kebar berak al hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda, shekkol mah sheokel veshoteh achar birkat hammazon — seuda acheret hi, lepi shebbirkat hammazon hi silluq vehessach haddaat lemah shellepaneha, vegam i epshar lishtot veleekol beodo mebarek. Umippene zeh nishtanna birkat hammazon mikkol debarim hatteunim kos, kegon qiddush vehabdala, birkat chatanim umila, shebbekullam birkat hayyayin qodemet, vekan mebarek "bore peri haggapen" achar birkat hammazon velo lepaneha, apillu im lo berak al hayyayin betok hasseuda, vaapillu berak, hare keshennatal hakkos beyado lebarek birkat hammazon hissiach dato millishtot qodem birkat hammazon, veim haya nimlak lishtot haya tzarik lachazor ulebarek, vekevan shekken, lamma eno mebarek "bore peri haggapen" qodem birkat hammazon? Ella lepi shebbebirkat hammazon hu modeh umeshabbeach leboreo al mah sheakal veshata — hu silluq vehessach haddaat al mah sheasa, vaapillu al birkat hammazon shemmebarek vehakkos beyado, lekak tzarik lebarek tekep lishtiyyato:

Kol dabar hattaun kos lo day baachizat hakkos lebaddah bishat amirat oto dabar, shezzeh eno meakkeb kelal bediabad, ella iqqar mah shehitinu kos hu lishtot mimmennu achar amirat oto dabar, shettehe otah amira keen shira hanneemeret al hayyayin shemmenassekin al gabbe hammizbeach, shehi shetiyyat hammizbeach, ap kan tehe neemeret shira al shetiyyat hayyayin. Veen shetiyya chashuba lomar shira ella im ken shoteh shiur harauy leyashsheb dato shel adam, shehu kimlo lugmayv, shehi shetiyya shel hanaa, ubepachot mishshiur zeh lo qiyyem mitzvat hakkos kelal. Vekol dabar shehakkos meakkeb bo apillu bediabad, sheim amar belo kos tzarik lachazor velomar al hakkos, kegon qiddush vehabdala, hu haddin im amar al hakkos velo shata mimmennu kimlo lugmayv miyyad qodem sheaqar mimmeqomo ubelo hessach haddaat benetayim — tzarik lachazor uleqaddesh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"a. Veken bebirkat hammazon lo qiyyem mitzvat hakkos kelal:

Vetzarik gam ken sheyyihyeh hayyayin bishat haamira etzlo al hashshulchan o al gabbe dabar acher beoto cheder mukan lishtiyya, vezehu gam ken meakkeb apillu bediabad, sheim en hayyayin lepanayv bishat haamira gam ken — eno niqra omer shira al hayyayin, mah sheen ken achizat hakkos beyado eno ella measara debarim shenneemru bekos lemitzva velo leakkeb, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g:

Ap al pi sheshshetiyyat kos shel beraka meakkebet, en meakkeb sheyyishteh hambarek beatzmo, ella day bishtiyyat acher, vaapillu matim mimmennu letinoq (kimlo lugmayv shel tinoq) — yatza yede choba (sheshshiur melo lugmayv hu bekol adam lepi mah shehu, haggadol lepi godlo, vehaqqatan lepi qotno). Ap al pi shehattinoq eno mechuyyab baddabar — en bekak kelum, lepi sheggam al hambarek lo chal hachiyyub kelal, shello chiyyebuhu ella lomar shira al hayyayin, sheyyishteh mimmennu ezeh adam miyyisrael sheyyihyeh shetiyya shehi chashuba hanaa lo (vaapillu tinoq ben yomo). Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tzarik lehatim letinoq gadol qetzat shehiggia liklal chinnuk birkat hannehenin, kede sheyyukal lebarek birkat hayyayin velo tehe birkato lebattala, mippene shehattinoq shomeah mimmennu umebarek veshoteh, mah sheen ken im yatim leqatan shello higgia lechinnuk — yapsid birkat hayyayin, shello yukal leomrah, ap al pi sheenah meakkebet. (Abal rashshay hu lehatim legadol, sheyyebarek beatzmo birkat hayyayin, im hu eno shoteh yayin mippene shessone oto o mishshum neder. Abal mi shehu shoteh yayin — mitzva min hammubchar sheyyitom beatzmo, veken lekol hamsubbim shezzimmen alehem, ak en tzarik lekol echad veechad kimlo lugmayv, ella day bitima kol shehu). Veyesh omerim shekkol dabar hattaun kos, chutz miqqiddush - lo hitzriku litom mimmennu ella mishshum shello yehe genay lebirkat hayyayin, sheyyomru shello letzorek hu beraka zo, veniret kibraka lebattala, abal beemet hu letzorek, shekkak tiqnu chakamim bekol shira hanneemeret al hayyayin sheyyesadderu otah etzel birkat hayyayin, shehu iqqar shira hammeyuchedet layyayin, lepikak rashshay lebarek birkat hayyayin ulehatim leqatan ap al pi shello higgia lechinnuk berakot, vaapillu eno yodea ledabber, shekkevan shehatteima enah ella mishshum genay — dayyah betinoq qatan kazeh. Veken nohagin bemila shebbeyom hakkippurim, hoil vei epshar beinyan acher, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trk"a. Abal bemaqom sheepshar, kegon qiddush shebbebet hakkeneset beshabbat veyom tob — yesh lachosh lassebara harishona lehatim leqatan shehiggia lechinnuk beraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rs"t. (Abal qiddush shebbabbayit, sheadam yotze bo yede chobato, yesh omerim, apillu lepi sebara haacharona, shello day bemah sheyyatim letinoq, velo apillu sheyyatim legadol, ella hamqaddesh beatzmo tzarik litom kimlo lugmayv, veim lav — lo yatza, mishshum shenneemar "zakor et yom hashshabbat leqaddesho", veameru chakamim: zakerehu al hayyayin, kelomar al shetiyyat hayyayin likbod hayyom, lepikak hammazkiro al hayyayin, hu hamqaddesh — shoteh mimmennu beatzmo. Verauy lachosh lazeh lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ra"a). Ulepi sebara zo shettaqqanat chakamim hu bekol dabar hattaun kos sheyyesadderu oto al birkat hayyayin, im ken mi sheeno shoteh yayin — i epshar lo lebarek birkat hammazon al hakkos ella im ken yatim mimmennu leqatan shehiggia lechinnuk, abal lo legadol sheyyebarek beatzmo, lepi shehambarek birkat hammazon hu beatzmo tzarik lebarek birkat hayyayin lepi sebara zo, vehu eno rashshay lebarek birkat hayyayin lachabero, ap lehaomerim shebbirkat hammazon teuna kos, shelledibrehem birkat hayyayin hi choba kebirkat hammitzvot sheadam yakol lehotzi chabero yede chobato, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z, mikkol maqom, kevan shechabero yakol lebarek beatzmo — en leacher lebarek lo. (Abal beqiddush vehabdala rashshay, shekkevan shetztzarik lebarek birkat qiddush vehabdala bishbil atzmo — yakol lomar gam birkat hayyayin shennitqena qodem birkat qiddush vehabdala, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ar"b). (Umikkol maqom, mi shebbemitzvotayv chapetz meod lebarek birkat hammazon bezimmun al hakkos — yukal lismok al sebara harishona lehaqel bedibre soperim. Veken behabdala, im lo taam kimlo lugmayv — en tzarik lachazor ulehabdil, shessepeq berakot shel dibrehem lehaqel, kassebara haacharona):

Ap al pi shemmitzva min hammubchar shekkol hamsubbim yitamu mikkos shel beraka — en tzarik litom mikkos hambarek, ella yakol kol echad litten koso lepanayv. Veyoter tob laasot ken im epshar, lepi shekkos hambarek hu pagum leachar sheshshata mimmennu hambarek. Veap sheepshar letaqqeno al yede sheyyosipu bo yayin lishtot kol echad veechad mehamsubbin, mikkol maqom, yoter tob sheyyitamu miyyayin shel beraka, shekkesheyyesh lipne kol echad veechad koso bishat birkat hammazon — hare kullam hen kosot shel beraka kemo kos hambarek. Veim lipne hamsubbin hen kosot reqanim, yakol litten mikkos habberaka meat lekol kos vekos shellahem achar shebberak "bore peri haggapen" qodem shetiyyato, kede sheyyitamu mikkos sheeno pagum. Veen bazeh mishshum hepseq ben beraka lishtiyya, kevan shehu letzorek shetiyyat hamsubbim, umah shehu mebarek — hu keillu hem mebarekim, shehare hem yotzeim bebirkato. Veken im kosot shellipnehem meleim, ella shehem pegumim — yakol lishpok mikkos shello letaqqenam qodem sheyyishteh. Vekevan shehem zequqim lekoso, en lahem litom ad sheyyitom hu, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z. Abal im enam zequqim lekoso, shekkosot shellahem meleim veenan pegumim — yekolim litom qodem sheyyitom hu:

Ap al pi shetteimat kos shel beraka day bekimlo lugmayv, bekos shel birkat hammazon tob lishtot rebiit, latzet mide sepeq beraka acharona, shekkimlo lugmayv beadam benoni hu rob rebiit, shehu yoter mikkezayit, umikkezayit ad rebiit yesh mistappeqim im tzarik lebarek beraka acharona, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"[y] . Veyoter merebiit en tzarik lishtot ap im hu adam gadol, shekkimlo lugmayv hu yoter merebiit. Umitzva ligmoa gemiot gassot, mishshum chibbub mitzva:

Im dato lishtot od — lo yebarek beraka acharona ad lebassop. Vehu sheddato lishtot od miyyad, sheim lo ken yesh lachosh shemma yitakkel mah sheshshata, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"d. Veim haya bedato lishtot miyyad vetaa uberak beraka acharona — en tzarik lebarek beraka rishona, kevan shehaya bedato lishtot od uberak betaut. Abal im berak bemitkavven, ap al pi sheddato lishtot od — tzarik lebarek beraka rishona, shekkol beraka acharona hi silluq vehessach haddaat lemah shellepaneha umapseqet, hoil vei epshar lishtot beodo mebarek, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Ap al pi shekkol hamsubbim yotzeim bebirkat hayyayin shebberak hambarek birkat hammazon, shehu mitkavven lehotziam yede chobatan, veap sheyyesh ezeh shehut ad sheyyaggia hakkos lekol echad veechad — en bazeh mishshum hepseq kol shello hipsiq bedibbur, mikkol maqom, bisuda gedola shehamsubbim rabbim veen yodeim ad hekan yaggia kos shel birkat hammazon, hare kol echad mehamsuppaqim im yaggia lo — tzarik lachazor ulebarek "bore peri haggapen" leatzmo, mippene shehu kenimlak, mippene shebbishat shemiato birkat hambarek lo yada im yaggia lo. Veim nitkavven bishmiato sheim yaggia lo sheyyetze yede chobato bishmia zo - yatza, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek leatzmo:
